title: Hosts and Hostesses, Restaurant, Lounge, and Coffee Shop
description: Welcome patrons, seat them at tables or in lounge, and help ensure quality of facilities and service.

projection.title: Hosts and hostesses, restaurant, lounge, and coffee shop

tasks.text: Provide guests with menus.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Menu presentation is live service interaction

dwas.name: Present food or beverage information or menus to customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Greet guests and seat them at tables or in waiting areas.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Physical seating arrangement and hosting

dwas.name: Assist customers with seating arrangements.

tasks.text: Maintain contact with kitchen staff, management, serving staff, and customers to ensure that dining details are handled properly and customers' concerns are addressed.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Order relay in live kitchen; AI can transcribe only

dwas.name: Communicate dining or order details to kitchen personnel.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Assign patrons to tables suitable for their needs and according to rotation so that servers receive an appropriate number of seatings.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Physical seating arrangement and hosting

dwas.name: Assist customers with seating arrangements.

tasks.text: Speak with patrons to ensure satisfaction with food and service, to respond to complaints, or to make conversation.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Satisfaction requires human relationship and accountability

dwas.name: Communicate with customers to resolve complaints or ensure satisfaction.
dwas.gwa_name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public

tasks.text: Inspect dining and serving areas to ensure cleanliness and proper setup.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical conformance inspection of facilities/equipment

dwas.name: Inspect facilities, equipment or supplies to ensure conformance to standards.

tasks.text: Supervise and coordinate activities of dining room staff to ensure that patrons receive prompt and courteous service.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Coordinating food service staff is live supervisory work

dwas.name: Coordinate activities of food service staff.

tasks.text: Answer telephone calls and respond to inquiries or transfer calls.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — General info answers assisted; live service human

dwas.name: Provide customers with general information or assistance.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Assist other restaurant workers by serving food and beverages, or by bussing tables.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on kitchen assistance

dwas.name: Assist chefs or caterers with food or drink preparation.

tasks.text: Inspect restrooms for cleanliness and availability of supplies, and clean restrooms when necessary.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical conformance inspection of facilities/equipment

dwas.name: Inspect facilities, equipment or supplies to ensure conformance to standards.

tasks.text: Take and prepare to-go orders.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Order taking automatable; customer rapport partly human

dwas.name: Package food or supplies.
Take customer orders.

tasks.text: Inform patrons of establishment specialties and features.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — General info answers assisted; live service human

dwas.name: Present food or beverage information or menus to customers.

dwas.name: Provide customers with general information or assistance.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Receive and record patrons' dining reservations.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI books reservations via tools; human handles issues

dwas.name: Schedule dining reservations.

tasks.text: Operate cash registers to accept payments for food and beverages.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Billing and payment processing largely automated

dwas.name: Operate cash registers.
Process customer bills or payments.

tasks.text: Direct patrons to coatrooms and waiting areas, such as lounges.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — General info answers assisted; live service human

dwas.name: Provide customers with general information or assistance.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Prepare cash receipts after establishments close, and make bank deposits.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Order or requisition supplies and equipment for tables and serving stations.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

dwas.name: Order materials, supplies, or equipment.

tasks.text: Hire, train, and supervise food and beverage service staff.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Broad HR work needs human judgment and accountability

dwas.name: Train food preparation or food service personnel.
Perform human resources activities.

tasks.rationale: text generation — Menu drafts aided; cost and kitchen constraints human

dwas.name: Plan menu options.

tasks.text: Perform marketing and advertising services.

dwas.name: Manage food service operations or parts of operations.
